title: Sprite Library: 68 Pixel Art Sprite Packs (Characters, Monsters, VFX) + Every New One
short_text: 68 pixel art sprite packs in one download, every new pack added free
description:
68 CSAF sprite packs in one download, worth $501.34 bought one by one, with Godot 4 SpriteFrames in 57 packs and RPG Maker MZ sheets in 46, for $19.99.

Buy once, keep every pack that joins.

How the future packs work

  • Every new CSAF sprite pack is added here on its launch day. You do not pay again: the files appear in your itch.io library.
  • Every addition gets a devlog post here, so follow the page to hear about it.

Latest additions

  • 2026-11-28: Cloud & Rail 03 joins with 8 rail vehicles in four directions with a moving loop: 528 PNG frames and sheets at 200x200 and 100x100. New here first: it has no page of its own yet.
  • 2026-11-27: Matchday 01 joins with two volleyball teams and a referee drawn for a side camera: 938 PNG frames and sheets at 192x192. New here first: it has no page of its own yet.
  • 12 earlier additions, each with its own devlog post below.
  • 2026-11-06: the Library opens with 54 packs, 61,992 PNG frames and sheets.

What's inside (68 packs)

Wildmark: fantasy heroes, their action sets, held items and MZ battlers (10 packs, $76.90 one by one): Handheld 01 (new here first), Wildmark 01, Wildmark 02, Wildmark 03, Wildmark 04, Wildmark Actions 01, Wildmark Actions 02, Wildmark Actions 03, Wildmark Actions 04, Wildmark Battlers.

Hearthhands: villagers, townsfolk and their portraits (9 packs, $65.25 one by one): Hearthhands 01, Hearthhands 02, Hearthhands 03, Hearthhands 04, Hearthhands 05, Hearthhands Hallowtide, Hearthhands Portraits, Hearthhands Side, The Working Year (new here first).

Mourncrest: undead, grave goods and portraits (7 packs, $41.93 one by one): Mourncrest 02, Mourncrest 03, Mourncrest 04, Mourncrest 05 (sold here; its old page is now another library), Mourncrest Portraits, Mourncrest Reforged 01, Mourncrest Reforged.

Kithfell: companions, pets, beasts and MZ battlers (6 packs, $46.94 one by one): Kithfell 01, Kithfell 02 Actions, Kithfell 02, Kithfell 03, Kithfell Companions, Kithfell Pet Shop.

Deepwarren: monsters with full combat sets and MZ battlers (4 packs, $33.96 one by one): Deepwarren 01, Deepwarren 02 (this page was its page), Deepwarren Battlers, Deepwarren Side.

Dreadmark: side-view bosses, eight states each, hit-flash and phase-2 sheets (1 pack, $14.99 one by one): Dreadmark (new here first).

Farmstead: livestock and farm animals (4 packs, $27.96 one by one): Farmstead 01 Actions, Farmstead 01, Farmstead 02, Farmstead 03.

Kept Year Faces: RPG dialogue portraits, five expressions each (1 pack, $7.99 one by one): Kept Year Faces (new here first).

Kept Year Cast: top-down field sprites of the same village, four facings (1 pack, $7.99 one by one): Kept Year Cast (new here first).

More casts: modern, cyberpunk, pirate, goblin, monster, creature-partner and sports rosters (9 packs, $67.91 one by one): Bestiary, Brinemark, Greenskin 01, Matchday 01 (new here first), Neonward 01, Neonward, Pocketfolk 01, Streetlight 01, Tamewild 01 (new here first).

Travel, wildlife and nature: travellers, carts, boats, airships and trains, birds, fish, trees and flora (8 packs, $55.60 one by one): Cart & Keel, Cloud & Rail 01 (new here first), Cloud & Rail 03 (new here first), Grovekeep 01, Skyfoundling 01, Tidewell 02 (new here first), Tidewell, Wayfarer 01.

VFX, ability icons and pixel fonts (8 packs, $53.92 one by one): Emberwrit 01, Emberwrit Skill Sets (new here first), Lantern & Tallow, Pixel Font Pairs Vol. 1 (new here first), Shroud & Sallow, Sigilcast 01, Sparkfall 01, Sparkfall 02.

What a pack contains

Every pack sits in its own folder exactly as its own page delivers it: PNG frames and sheets at their native grid sizes, its own Readme and its own licence. 57 packs carry Godot 4 SpriteFrames, 46 carry RPG Maker MZ sheets, 3 carry GameMaker files and three are pixel fonts with TrueType and BMFont files. Every pack works in any engine that reads PNG, including Unity and GameMaker.

Licence

You can use the sprites in commercial and personal games, with no royalty and no credit required, and edit them freely. You can't resell or share the sprites or fonts themselves as an asset pack, or use them to train a model. Each pack's own LICENSE.txt governs its folder.

The art in 62 of the 68 packs is generated with an AI pixel art model (PixelLab, on a paid plan that grants commercial use), then palette locked and checked by our own tooling. The three font packs, Emberwrit Skill Sets, Sparkfall 01 and Sparkfall 02 were drawn by code. The tooling was written with AI assistance.

Try before you buy

Free samplers from the same families: Mourncrest 00, Farmstead 00, Wildmark Sampler, Hearthhands Sampler, Kithfell Sampler, Deepwarren Sampler.

Questions: post a comment below. A pack you want next: the Request Desk. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

$19.99 now. The price may rise for new buyers as the library grows; any rise is announced here with its date. Buyers keep every pack.

Shipping on Steam? Steam's Content Survey asks you to describe content made with the help of AI tools that ships in your game, and the note above says how these sprites were made. A line you can adapt: "Some sprites in this game come from a third party asset library and were generated with an AI pixel art model or by code written with AI tools."

Made something with this? Post it below and we will add it to our Made With collection.

devlog.title: Sprite Library: Cloud & Rail 03 joins with 8 rail vehicles, 68 packs now
devlog.html:
Cloud & Rail 03 (Mine and Rail) is now in the Sprite Library: eight rail vehicles (mine cart empty, mine cart ore, mine cart coal, handcar, steam engine, goods wagon, timber wagon and passenger coach), each in four directions with a still and a moving loop. The Library now holds 68 packs, worth $501.34 bought one by one, for $19.99. If you own it, download it again from your itch.io library: it is in road-wild-and-water/cloud-and-rail-03-mine-and-rail/.

  • 448 frame PNGs and 32 sheets at 200x200 and 100x100, with eight Godot 4 SpriteFrames per grid (16 in all) and 16 RPG Maker MZ character sheets.
  • Every vehicle has a still and a 6-frame moving loop in each of the four directions, standing on one ground row of the 200 px cell, the same cell and ground line as Cart & Keel, so the carts, boats and trains sit in one game.
  • Twenty-four of the thirty-two loops are a gentle mechanical rumble made by our code, the wheels fixed and the body riding a pixel or two; the others are generated: the spoked wheels turning, the handcar's pump and the engine's driving rods.
  • The west views are the east ones mirrored, so the two sides always agree.

It is new here first: it has no page of its own yet, so for now the Library is the place to get it. It is part three of the three-part Cloud & Rail volume; Cloud & Rail 01: The Sky is already here, and The World Map joins when built. The vehicles and their generated loops were made by PixelLab, a generative AI pixel-art model, on a paid plan whose terms permit commercial use, then placed on one cell, palette-locked and checked frame by frame; the mechanical loops, the mirrored west views and a few repaired details are made by code from those frames.

The price stays $19.99. The price may rise for new buyers as the library grows; any rise is announced here with its date. Buyers keep every pack.

Every new CSAF sprite pack joins this page on its launch day, at no cost to anyone who owns it. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.
